repository.name: @webex/helper-html
repository.purpose: Browser HTML allow-list filter for the Cisco Webex JS SDK. The browser build sanitizes tags, attributes, styles, and URL schemes. The Node build returns the input string for the filter exports, while escape and escapeSync always encode angle brackets and ampersands.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/helper-html package barrel
entrypoints: import { escape, escapeSync, filter, filterSync, filterEscape, filterEscapeSync, DEFAULT_ALLOWED_URL_SCHEMES } from '@webex/helper-html'
public_interfaces.audience: Workspace consumers, including @webex/internal-plugin-conversation, plus external npm consumers
public_interfaces.notes: Seven named exports. package.json browser field replaces src/html.js and dist/html.js with the shim.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.notes: package.json scripts.test chains test:unit and test:integration, which are not defined. The unit spec runs through test:browser.

refresh_with: update alongside the behavior change in the same commit

generated_artifacts.refresh_with: A symlink to the monorepo-root template set, so this package holds no template copies of its own.

recommended: confirm URL scheme and tag allow-list cases in test/unit/spec/html.js

change_impact.notes: Conversation imports filter and filterEscape from the package root. Removing or renaming an export is breaking.

evidence_rules.requirement: A documented command must exist in package.json scripts or be the workspace install command.
evidence_rules.notes: test:unit and test:integration are named by scripts.test and are not defined.

evidence_rules.requirement: A symbol is public only if re-exported from the barrel.
evidence_rules.notes: Consumers import from the package root. There are no subpath exports.

evidence_rules.requirement: Ground every behavioral claim in source or the browser unit spec.
evidence_rules.notes: README.md is a retained product document and is not the behavioral authority.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat the Node filter exports as a sanitizer.
negative_guidance.why: src/html.js returns the original html string. Sanitizing behavior lives in src/html.shim.js, selected by the package.json browser field.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not document filter as a three-argument function of allowed tags, styles, and html.
negative_guidance.why: The implementation curries with arity 4 and the first argument is processCallback. The product README describes a different signature and is retained unchanged.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not allow javascript, vbscript, or data URL schemes through additionalAllowedUrlSchemes.
negative_guidance.why: src/html.shim.js drops those schemes even when the caller lists them.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not run package.json scripts.test as the verification command.
negative_guidance.why: It chains test:unit and test:integration, which this package.json does not define.

high.expectation: Source and the browser unit spec both support the change.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, which is the case for the Node noop path because the unit spec is skipped in Node.

low.expectation: Neither source nor the unit spec settles the question. Stop and report the gap.
